#### Ṛk 10

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> विप्रं॒ होता॑रम॒द्रुहं॑ धू॒मके॑तुं वि॒भाव॑सुं ।  
> य॒ज्ञानां॑ के॒तुमी॑महे ॥ १० ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> विप्रं । होतारं । अद्रुहं । धूमकेतुं । विभावसुं ।  
> यज्ञानां । केतुं । ईमहे ॥ १० ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> विप्रं मेधाविनं होतारं देवानामाह्वातारमद्रुहमद्रोग्द्धारं धूमकेतुं धूमध्वजं विभावसुं दीप्तिधनं यज्ञानां केतुं पताकस्थानीयमग्निमीमहे । अभीष्टं याचामहे ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: we ask for what we desire from Agni, who is wise, the Hotṛ who calls the gods, free from malice, whose banner is smoke, whose wealth is radiance, and who is like the banner of the sacrifices.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- विप्रं (*vipraṃ*)—the wise
- होतारं (*hotāraṃ*)—in the form of the Hotṛ
- अद्रुहं (*adruhaṃ*)—free from malice
- धूमकेतुं (*dhūmaketuṃ*)—whose banner is smoke
- विभावसुं (*vibhāvasuṃ*)—whose wealth is radiance
- यज्ञानां (*yajñānāṃ*)—of the sacrifices
- केतुं (*ketuṃ*)—the banner
- ईमहे (*īmahe*)—we ask for our desired objects

### Printed p. 434

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

We ask for our desired objects from Agni, who is wise, in the form of the Hotṛ, free from malice, whose banner is smoke, whose wealth is radiance, and who is the banner of the sacrifices.

##### English translation
We solicit the wise invoker (of the gods), the beneficent, the smoke-bannered, the resplendent, the banner of the sacrifices.

#### Ṛk 11

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> अग्ने॒ नि पा॑हि न॒स्त्वं प्रति॑ ष्म देव॒ रीष॑तः ।  
> भिं॒धि द्वेषः॑ सहस्कृत ॥ ११ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> अग्ने । नि । पाहि । नः । त्वं । प्रति । स्म । देव । रिषतः ।  
> भिंधि । द्वेषः । सहःकृत ॥ ११ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> हे सहस्कृत बलेन कृत देव दीप्ताग्ने रिषतो हिंसकान्नोऽस्मान् प्रति नि
> पाहि । प्रतिरक्ष । स्मेति पूरणः । द्वेषो द्विषः शत्रुंश्च भिंधि । विदारय ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa addresses the shining Agni, born of strength: protect us thoroughly against those who would injure us (the word स्म (*sma*) is a mere expletive), and split asunder our enemies and haters.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- सहस्कृत (*sahaskṛta*)—born of strength
- देव (*deva*)—shining
- अग्ने (*agne*)—O Agni
- नः (*naḥ*)—us
- त्वं (*tvaṃ*)—you
- रिषतः प्रति (*riṣataḥ prati*)—from the injuring enemies
- नि पाहि (*ni pāhi*)—protect completely
- द्वेषः (*dveṣaḥ*)—our enemies
- भिंधि (*bhiṃdhi*)—destroy

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O shining Agni, born of strength, protect us completely from our injuring enemies. Destroy our enemies.

##### English translation
Divine Agni, produced by strength, protect us from the injurer, tear asunder our enemies.

#### Ṛk 12

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> अ॒ग्निः प्र॒श्नेन॒ मन्म॑ना॒ शुंभा॑नस्त॒न्वं१॒॑ १ स्वां ।  
> क॒विर्विप्रे॑ण वावृधे ॥ १२ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> अग्निः । प्रश्नेन । मन्मना । शुंभानः । तन्वं । स्वां ।  
> कविः । विप्रेण । ववृधे ॥ १२ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> कविः क्रांतकर्माग्निः प्रश्नेन पुराणेन मन्मना मननीयेन स्तोत्रेण स्वां
> स्वकीयां तन्वं तनुमंगं शुंभानः शोभयन् विप्रेण मेधाविना स्तोत्रा
> वावृथे । प्रवृद्धो भवति ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: Agni, the wise one of far-reaching action, adorning his own body with the ancient hymn, which is worthy of meditation, grows strong through the wise praiser.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- कविः (*kaviḥ*)—endowed with wise insight
- अग्निः (*agniḥ*)—Agni
- प्रश्नेन (*praśnena*)—with the ancient
- मन्मना (*manmanā*)—and meditative hymn
- स्वां (*svāṃ*)—his own
- तन्नं (*tannaṃ*)—body **NOTE**
- शुंभानः (*śuṃbhānaḥ*)—adorning
- विप्रेण (*vipreṇa*)—with the help of the wise praiser
- ववृधे (*vavṛdhe*)—grows

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

Agni, endowed with wise insight, adorning his own body with the ancient and meditative hymn, grows with the help of the wise praiser.

##### English translation
The wise Agni, beautifying his body with the ancient hymn has grown in might through the intelligent hymner.

#### Ṛk 13

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> ऊ॒र्जो नपा॑त॒मा हु॑वे॒ऽग्निं पा॑व॒कशो॑चिषं ।  
> अ॒स्मिन्न॒ज्ञे स्व॑ध्व॒रे ॥ १३ ॥

### Printed p. 436

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> ऊर्जः । नपातं । आ । हुवे । अग्निं । पावकशोचिषं ।  
> अस्मिन् । यज्ञे । सुअध्वरे ॥ १३ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> ऊर्जोऽन्नस्य नपातं पुत्रं पावकशोचिषं शोधकदीप्तिमग्निं स्वध्वरेऽसुरैरत्यंतमहिंस्येऽस्मिन्नज्ञ आ हुवे । आह्वयामि ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: I call to this sacrifice, which is well performed and which the Asuras cannot injure, Agni, the son of food, whose radiance purifies.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- ऊर्जः (*ūrjaḥ*)—of food
- नपातं (*napātaṃ*)—the son
- पावकशोचिषं (*pāvakaśociṣaṃ*)—of purifying radiance
- अग्निं (*agniṃ*)—Agni
- स्वध्वरे (*svadhvare*)—free from injury by the Asuras
- अस्मिन् यज्ञे (*asmin yajñe*)—in this sacrifice
- आ हुवे (*ā huve*)—I call with prayer

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

I call with prayer, in this sacrifice that is not subject to injury by the Asuras, Agni, the son of food, whose radiance purifies.

##### English translation
I invoke Agni of purifying lustre, the son of (sacrificial) food in this inviolable sacrifice.

#### Ṛk 14

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> स नो॑ मित्रमह॒स्त्वमग्ने॑ शु॒क्रेण॑ शो॒चिषा॑ ।  
> दे॒वैरा स॑त्सि ब॒र्हिषि॑ ॥ १४ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> सः । नः । मित्रमहः । त्वं । अग्ने । शुक्रेण । शोचिषा ।  
> देवैः । आ । सत्सि । बर्हिषि ॥ १४ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> हे मित्रमहो मित्राणां पूजनीयाग्ने स त्वं शुक्रेण ज्वलता तेजसा
> तेजसा देवैः सह बर्हिषि यज्ञ आ सत्सि । आसीद ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa addresses Agni, the adorable one of friends: with bright, blazing splendour, together with the gods, be seated on the sacred grass at the sacrifice.

### Printed p. 437

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- मित्रमह (*mitramaha*)—worthy of worship by friends
- अग्ने (*agne*)—O Agni
- सः त्वं (*saḥ tvaṃ*)—you, the renowned
- शुक्रेण (*śukreṇa*)—blazing
- रोचिषा (*rociṣā*)—with radiance **NOTE**
- देवैः (*devaiḥ*)—with the gods
- नः बर्हिषि (*naḥ barhiṣi*)—in our sacrifice
- आ सत्सि (*ā satsi*)—sit down

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O Agni, worthy of worship by friends, you, the renowned, sit down with the gods in our sacrifice, joined with your blazing radiance.

##### English translation
O Agni, adorable to your friends, sit down with the gods on our sacred grass with your resplendent radiance.

#### Ṛk 15

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> यो अ॒ग्निं त॒न्नो॒३॒॑ ३ दमे॑ दे॒वं मर्तः॑ सप॒र्यति॑ ।  
> तस्मा॒ इद्दी॑दय॒द्वसु॑ ॥ १५ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> यः । अग्निं । तन्वः । दमे । देवं । मर्तः । सपर्यति ।  
> तस्मै । इत् । दीदयत् । वसु ॥ १५ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> यो मर्तो मनुष्यो दमे गृहेग्निं देवं तन्नो धनस्य प्राप्त्यर्थमिति
> शेषः । भोजनं तनेति धननामसु पाठात् । सपर्यति परिचरति तस्मा इत्तस्मा एव
> वसु धनं दीदयत् । सोग्निः प्रयच्छति ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: the mortal who in his house serves the god Agni for the attainment of wealth (the words "for the attainment of" are to be supplied), to him alone Agni gives wealth. Sāyaṇa takes तन्नो (*tanno*) as a word for wealth, relying on its place among the names of wealth in the list of words (the Nighaṇṭu), where "food" is also read.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- यः मर्तः (*yaḥ martaḥ*)—the man who
- दमे (*dame*)—in his house
- देवं (*devaṃ*)—the divine
- अग्निं (*agniṃ*)—Agni
- तन्वः (*tanvaḥ*)—for the attainment of wealth
- सपर्यति (*saparyati*)—worships
- तस्मा इत् (*tasmā it*)—to that sacrificer alone
- वसु (*vasu*)—wealth
- दीदयत् (*dīdayat*)—Agni gives

### Printed p. 438

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

The man who in his house worships the divine Agni for the attainment of wealth, to that sacrificer alone Agni gives wealth.

##### English translation
Whatsoever mortal worships the divine Agni in his house (for the attainment) of wealth, to him he gives riches.

#### Ṛk 16

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> अ॒ग्नि मू॒र्धा दि॒वः क॒कुत्पतिः॑ पृथि॒व्या अ॒यं ।  
> अ॒पां रेतां॑सि जिन्वति ॥ १६ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> अग्निः । मूर्धा । दिवः । ककुत् । पतिः । पृथिव्याः । अयं ।  
> अपां । रेतांसि । जिन्वति ॥ १६ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> मूर्धा देवानां श्रेष्ठो दिवो द्युलोकस्य ककुदुच्च्रितः पृथिव्याश्च
> पतिरयमग्निरसां रेतांस्थि स्थावरजंगमात्मकानि भूतानि जिन्वति । प्रीणयति ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: this Agni, the head, that is the best of the gods, the summit of the heaven-world, and the lord of the earth, gladdens (प्रीणयति (*prīṇayati*)) the seeds of the waters, the beings that are of the nature of the moving and the unmoving. **NOTE**

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- मूर्धा (*mūrdhā*)—the best among all the gods
- दिवः (*divaḥ*)—in the heaven-world
- ककुत् (*kakut*)—standing in an exalted position
- पृथिव्याः (*pṛthivyāḥ*)—of the earth
- पतिः (*patiḥ*)—the lord
- अयं अग्निः (*ayaṃ agniḥ*)—this Agni
- अपां (*apāṃ*)—of the waters
- रेतांसि (*retāṃsi*)—all the beings in the form of seeds
- जिन्नति (*jinnati*)—satisfies **NOTE**

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

This Agni, the best among all the gods, standing in an exalted position in the heaven-world, the lord of the earth, satisfies all the beings that are the seeds of the waters.

##### English translation
Agni, the head (of the gods), the summit of heaven,—he the lord of the earth,—gladdens the seed of the waters.

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> तव॒ ज्योतीं॑ष्य॒र्चयः॑ ॥ १७ ॥

- तव (*tava*)—your

- शुक्राः (*śukrāḥ*)—of bright colour
- भ्राजंतः (*bhrājaṃtaḥ*)—shining
- अर्चयः (*arcayaḥ*)—rays
- ज्योतींषि (*jyotīṃṣi*)—splendours
- उदीरते (*udīrate*)—cause to spread out

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O Agni, your pure, bright and shining rays cause your splendours to spread out.

##### English translation
Agni, your pure, bright, shining flames send forth your splendours.

#### Ṛk 18

> स्तो॒ता स्यां॒ तव॒ शर्म॑णि ॥ १८ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> ईशिषे । वार्यस्य । हि । दात्रस्य । अग्ने । स्वःपतिः ।  
> स्तोता । स्यां । तव । शर्मणि ॥ १८ ॥

### Printed p. 440

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> हे अग्ने स्वर्पतिः स्वर्गस्य स्वामिा त्वं वार्यस्य वरणीयस्य दात्रस्य दातव्यस्य
> धनस्येशिषे । ईश्वरोऽसि । शर्मणि सुखे निमित्ते तव स्तोता स्यां। भवेयं ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: O Agni, lord of heaven, you have mastery over wealth that is desirable and fit to be given. For the sake of happiness may I be your praiser.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- अग्ने (*agne*)—O Agni
- स्वर्पतिः (*svarpatiḥ*)—you, the lord of heaven
- वार्यस्य (*vāryasya*)—desired
- दात्रस्य (*dātrasya*)—fit to be given
- ईशिषे हि (*īśiṣe hi*)—you are the master
- शर्मणि (*śarmaṇi*)—for our happiness
- तव (*tava*)—your
- स्तोता (*stotā*)—praiser
- स्यां (*syāṃ*)—I become

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O Agni, you, the lord of heaven, are master of all wealth that is desired by all and fit to be given. For our happiness I become your praiser.

##### English translation
Agni, lord of heaven, you preside over (all) that is to be desired or given ; may I be your eulogist for happiness.

#### Ṛk 19

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> त्वां व॑र्धंतु नो॒ गिरः॑ ॥ १९ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> श्वां । अग्ने । मनीषिणः । त्वां । हिन्वंति । चित्तभिः ।  
> त्वां । वर्धंतु । नः । गिरः ॥ १९ ॥

**NOTE**

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> हे अग्ने त्वां मनीषिणो मनस ईश्वराः स्तोतारः स्तुतिभिः स्तुवंतीति शेषः।
> किंच त्वामेव चित्तिभिः कर्मभिर्हिन्वंति । प्रीणयंति । नोऽस्माकं गिरः स्तुतयस्त्यामेव वर्धंतु । वर्धयंतु ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: O Agni, the wise, who are masters of their minds, the praisers, praise you with their hymns (the word "praise" is to be supplied). Moreover they gladden you with their rites. May our praises make you grow.

- अग्ने (*agne*)—O Agni
- त्वां (*tvāṃ*)—you
- मनीषिणः (*manīṣiṇaḥ*)—praisers of steadfast resolve
- चित्तिभिः (*cittibhiḥ*)—with excellent rites
- हिन्वंति (*hinvaṃti*)—they satisfy
- नः (*naḥ*)—our
- गिरः (*giraḥ*)—praises
- वर्धंतु (*vardhaṃtu*)—may they make grow

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O Agni, praisers of steadfast resolve praise you. They satisfy you with excellent rites. May our praises make you grow.

##### English translation
You, Agni, the wise (praise), you they rejoice with (pious) rites ; may our praises invigorate you.

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> अ॒ग्नेः स॒ख्यं वृ॑णीमहे ॥ २० ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> अदब्बस्य । स्वधावतः । दूतस्य । रेभतः । सदा ।  
> अग्नेः । सख्यं । वृणीमहे ॥ २० ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> हे अग्ने अदब्धस्य केनाप्यहिंसितस्य स्वधावतो बलवतो दूतस्य देवानां
> रेभतो देवान् स्तुवतस्तव सख्यं सदा वयं वृणीमहे ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: O Agni, unharmed by anyone, strong, the messenger of the gods, who praises the gods, we always choose your friendship.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- अदब्बस्य (*adabbasya*)—of the unharmed
- स्वधावतः (*svadhāvataḥ*)—of the powerful
- दूतस्य (*dūtasya*)—of the messenger of the gods
- रेभतः (*rebhataḥ*)—who praises the gods
- अग्नेः (*agneḥ*)—of Agni
- सख्यं (*sakhyaṃ*)—the friendship
- सदा (*sadā*)—always
- वृणीमहे (*vṛṇīmahe*)—we desire

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

We always desire the friendship of Agni, who is unharmed, powerful, the messenger of the gods, and the praiser of the gods.

### Printed p. 442

##### English translation
We ever choose the friendship of Agni, the unharmed, the strong, the messenger, the praiser (of the gods).

#### Ṛk 21

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> अ॒ग्निः शुचि॑व्रततमः॒ शुचि॒र्विप्रः॒ शुचिः॑ क॒विः ।  
> शुची॑ रोचत॒ आहु॑तः ॥ २१ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> अग्निः । शुचिव्रततमः । शुचिः । विप्रः । शुचिः । कविः ।  
> शुचिः । रोचते । आहुतः ॥ २१ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> शुचिव्रततमोऽतिशयेन शुद्धकर्मा शुचिः शुद्ध एव विप्रो मेधान्वी शुचिः
> शुद्धः सन्नेव कविः क्रांतकर्मा शुचिरेवाहुतोऽग्नी रोचते । प्रकाशते ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: Agni, supremely pure in his acts, pure, wise, pure and of far-reaching action, pure indeed, being offered into, shines forth.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- शुचिव्रततमः (*śucivratatamaḥ*)—whose acts are wholly pure
- शुचिः (*śuciḥ*)—pure
- विप्रः (*vipraḥ*)—wise
- कविः (*kaviḥ*)—of far-reaching action
- आहुतः (*āhutaḥ*)—one to whom the offering is made
- अग्निः (*agniḥ*)—Agni
- रोचते (*rocate*)—shines

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

Agni, whose acts are wholly pure, pure and wise, pure and of far-reaching action, to whom the offering is made in purity, shines forth.

##### English translation
The pure Agni shines forth when worshipped,—the purest offerer, the pure priest, the pure sage.

#### Ṛk 22

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> उ॒त त्वा॑ धी॒तयो॒ मम॒ गिरो॑ वर्धंतु वि॒श्वहा॑ ।  
> अग्ने॑ स॒ख्यस्य॑ बोधि नः ॥ २२ ॥

### Printed p. 443

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> उत । त्वा । धीतॆयः । मम । गिरः । वर्धंतु । विश्वहा ।  
> अग्ने । सख्यस्य । बोधि । नः ॥ २२ ॥

**NOTE**

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> उतापि च हे अग्ने त्वा त्वां मम धीतयः कर्माणि गिरः स्तुतयश्च विश्वहा
> सर्वदा वर्धंतु । वर्धयंतु । नोऽस्माकं सख्यस्य सख्यं सखिकर्म स्तुत्यादिकं
> बोधि । बुध्यस्व ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: And, O Agni, may my rites and my praises make you grow at all times. Be mindful of the friendly offices, the praises and the like, that are ours.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- उत (*uta*)—and
- अग्ने (*agne*)—O Agni
- मम (*mama*)—my
- धीतयः (*dhītayaḥ*)—rites
- गिरः (*giraḥ*)—praises
- त्वा (*tvā*)—you
- विश्वहा (*viśvahā*)—always
- वर्धंतु (*vardhaṃtu*)—may they make grow
- सख्यस्य (*sakhyasya*)—friendship
- भोधि (*bhodhi*)—know **NOTE**

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O Agni, may my rites and praises always make you grow. Take note of our friendship.

##### English translation
May my rites also and my praises ever invigorate you: Agni, take thought of our friendship.

#### Ṛk 23

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> यद॑ग्ने॒ स्याम॒हं त्वं त्वं वा॑ घा॒ स्या अ॒हं ।  
> सुष्टे॑ स॒त्या इ॒हाशिषः॑ ॥ २३ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> यत् । अग्ने । स्यां । अहं । त्वं । त्वं । वा । घ । स्याः । अहं ।  
> स्युः । ते । सत्याः । इह । आशिषः ॥ २३ ॥

**NOTE**

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> हे अग्ने यद्यद्यहं त्वं बहुधनः स्यां भवेयं त्वं वा घ त्वं ना खल्वहं
> दरिद्रः स्तोता स्याः भवेः ततस्तवाशिष आशासनानीहासद्विषये सत्याः सत्यानि स्युः ।
> भवेयुः ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: O Agni, if I were you, rich in wealth, or if you were truly I, a poor praiser, then the wishes of you, the praiser, would come true in this matter.

### Printed p. 444

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- अग्ने (*agne*)—O Agni
- यत् (*yat*)—if by chance
- अहं (*ahaṃ*)—I
- त्वं (*tvaṃ*)—you, the rich
- स्यां (*syāṃ*)—I were
- वा (*vā*)—or
- त्सं घ (*tsaṃ gha*)—you indeed **NOTE**
- स्याः (*syāḥ*)—you were
- इह (*iha*)—in this matter
- ते आशिषः (*te āśiṣaḥ*)—all your desires
- सत्याः (*satyāḥ*)—to be fulfilled
- स्युः (*syuḥ*)—would surely become

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O Agni, if I were in your form and master of wealth, or if you were in the form of me, the poor one, then your desires would surely be fulfilled.

##### English translation
Agni, if I were you or you were I, your wishes here should come true.

#### Ṛk 24

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> वसु॒र्वसु॑पति॒र्हि क॒मस्य॑ग्ने वि॒भाव॑सुः ।  
> स्याम॑ ते सुम॒तावसि॑ ॥ २४ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> वसुः । वसुपतिः । हि । कं । असि । अग्ने । विभावसुः ।  
> स्याम । ते । सुमतौ । आपि ॥ २४ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> हे अग्ने त्वं विभावसुर्दिप्तिधनो वसुपतिर्धनपतिर्वसुर्वासयिता चासि
> भवसि हि यस्मात् अतो वयमपि ते तव सुमतावनुग्रहबुद्धौ स्याम । भवेम ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: O Agni, you are the one whose wealth is radiance, the lord of wealth, and the one who gives dwelling. Therefore may we also be in your favourable thought.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- अग्ने (*agne*)—O Agni
- विभावसुः (*vibhāvasuḥ*)—whose wealth is radiance
- वसुपतिः (*vasupatiḥ*)—lord of wealth
- वसुः (*vasuḥ*)—giver of dwelling
- आसि (*āsi*)—you are
- हि (*hi*)—therefore
- ते (*te*)—your
- सुमतौ (*sumatau*)—in favourable thought
- स्याम (*syāma*)—may we be

### Printed p. 445

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O Agni, you are one whose wealth is radiance, the lord of wealth. For that very reason may we too become worthy of your favour.

##### English translation
Agni, you are rich in splendour, the lord of wealth, and the giver of dwellings; may we too abide in your favour.

#### Ṛk 25

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> अग्ने॑ धृ॒तव्र॑ताय ते समु॒द्राये॑व॒ सिंध॑वः ।  
> गिरो॑ वा॒श्रास॑ ईरते ॥ २५ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> अग्ने । धृतव्रताय । ते । समुद्राय इव । सिंधवः ।  
> गिरः । वाश्रासः । ईरते ॥ २५ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> हे अग्ने धृतव्रताय धृतकर्मणे ते तुभ्यं वाश्रासो नाशनशीला गिरो मम
> स्तुतयः सिंधवो नद्यः समुद्रायेव यथा समुद्राय तथेरते । प्रवर्तंते ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: O Agni, to you who uphold the rites, my praises, which are of a destroying nature, go forth as rivers go to the sea; that is, they proceed to you. **NOTE**

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- अग्ने (*agne*)—O Agni
- सिंधवः (*siṃdhavaḥ*)—rivers
- समुद्राय इव (*samudrāya iva*)—as they flow towards the sea
- वाश्रासः (*vāśrāsaḥ*)—that make sound
- गिरः (*giraḥ*)—my praises
- धृतव्रताय (*dhṛtavratāya*)—to you, the upholder of vows
- ते (*te*)—towards you
- ईरते (*īrate*)—they move

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O Agni, as rivers flow towards the sea, my loud praises move towards you, who uphold the rites (who are the instrument for the performance of rites).

##### English translation
Agni, my loud praises proceed to you, observant of pious rites, as rivers to the sea.

### Printed p. 446

#### Ṛk 26

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> युवा॑नं वि॒श्वतिं॑ क॒विं वि॒श्वादं॑ पुरु॒वेप॑सं ।  
> अ॒ग्निं शुं॑भामि॒ मन्म॑भिः ॥ २६ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> युवानं । विश्वतिं । कविं । विश्वअदं । पुरुवेपसं ।  
> अग्निं । शुंभामि । मन्मभिः ॥ २६ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> युवानं नित्यतरुणं विश्वतिं विशां पतिं कविं क्रांतकर्माणं विश्वादं सर्वस्य
> हविषोत्तारं पुरुवेपसं बहुकर्माणं । वेशो वेप इति कर्मनामसु पाठात् ।
> अग्निं मन्मभिर्मननीयैः स्तोत्रैः शुंभामि । शोभयामि ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: Agni is ever young, the lord of the people (विश्वतिं (*viśvatiṃ*) explained as lord of the clans), a seer, that is one of far-reaching works, the eater of all, that is the consumer of every oblation, and one of many works; for वेशो वेप इति कर्मनामसु पाठात् (*veśo vepa iti karmanāmasu pāṭhāt*) (veśa and vepa are read among the names of action). Agni I adorn, that is I beautify, with hymns fit to be meditated on.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- युवानं (*yuvānaṃ*)—the ever-young
- विश्वतिं (*viśvatiṃ*)—the protector of the people
- कविं (*kaviṃ*)—one of far-reaching works
- विश्वादं (*viśvādaṃ*)—the eater of all oblations
- पुरुवेपसं (*puruvepasaṃ*)—one of many kinds of works
- अग्निं (*agniṃ*)—Agni
- मन्मभिः (*manmabhiḥ*)—with meditative praises
- शुंभामि (*śuṃbhāmi*)—I adorn, that is, I praise

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

I adorn, that is I praise, with meditative praises Agni, who is ever young, the protector of the people, and one of far-reaching works.

##### English translation
I glorify with hymns the ever-young Agni, the lord of men, the wise the all-devouring, the performer of many acts.

#### Ṛk 27

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> य॒ज्ञानां॑ र॒थ्ये॑ व॒यं ति॒ग्मजं॑भाय वी॒ळवे॑ ।  
> स्तोमै॑रिषेमा॒ग्नये॑ ॥ २७ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> यज्ञानां । रथ्ये । वयं । तिग्मजंभाय । वीळपे ।  
> सोमैः । इषेम । आग्नये ॥ २७ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> यज्ञानां रथ्ये नेत्रे तिग्मजंभाय तीक्ष्णज्वालाय वीळवे बलवतेऽग्नये
> स्तोमैः स्तोत्रैर्वयमांगिरसा इषेम । स्तुतिं कर्तुमिच्छेम ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: to Agni, the leader of sacrifices, of sharp flame, the mighty, we, the Āṅgirasas, wish to offer praise with hymns of praise.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- यज्ञानां (*yajñānāṃ*)—for sacrifices
- रथ्ये (*rathye*)—the leader
- तिग्मजंभाय (*tigmajaṃbhāya*)—of sharp flame
- वीळवे (*vīḷave*)—the mighty
- अग्नये (*agnaye*)—to Agni
- स्तोमैः (*stomaiḥ*)—with hymns of praise
- वयं (*vayaṃ*)—we
- इषेम (*iṣema*)—wish to praise

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

We wish to praise with hymns Agni, who is the leader of sacrifices, of sharp flame, and mighty.

##### English translation
Let us seek with our hymns Agni, the conductor of the sacrifices, the mighty, the sharp-jawed.

#### Ṛk 28

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> अ॒यम॑ग्ने॒ त्वे अपि॑ जरि॒ता भू॑तु संत्य ।  
> तस्मै॑ पावक मृळय ॥ २८ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> अयं । अग्ने । त्वे इति । अपि । जरिता । भूतु । संत्य ।  
> तस्मै । पावक । मृळय ॥ २८ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> हे पावक शोधक संत्य भजनीयाग्ने त्वे अपि त्वय्यप्ययमस्मदीयो
> जनो जरिता स्तोता भूतु । भवतु । तस्यॆ जरित्रे मृळयॆ । सुखमुत्पादय । कं
> सुखय वा ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: O Agni, purifier, adorable (संत्य (*saṃtya*) explained as one to be resorted to), may this our man become a praiser in you also; to that praiser grant happiness, or make him happy (कं (*kaṃ*) is explained as happiness).

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- पावक (*pāvaka*)—O purifier
- संत्य (*saṃtya*)—O worshipful one
- अग्ने (*agne*)—O Agni
- आयं (*āyaṃ*)—this our people
- त्वे अपि (*tve api*)—you also
- जरिता (*jaritā*)—as praising people
- भूतु (*bhūtu*)—let them be

- मृळय (*mṛḷaya*)—bring happiness

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

#### Ṛk 29

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> धीरो॒ ह्यस्य॑द्म॒सद्विप्रो॒ न जागृ॑विः॒ सदा॑ ।  
> अग्ने॑ दी॒दय॑सि॒ द्यवि॑ ॥ २९ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> धीरः । हि । असि । अद्मसत् । विप्रः । न । जागृविः । सदा ।  
> अग्ने । दीदयसि । द्यवि ॥ २९ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> हे अग्ने त्वं धीरोऽसि हि । भवसि खलु । अद्मसद्धविषि सीदन्विप्रो न मेधावीव जागृविः प्रजानां हितकरणे जागरणशीलोऽसि । सदा द्यव्यंतरिक्षे दीदयसि ।
> दीव्यसि च ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: O Agni, you are steadfast; sitting at the oblation you are like a wise man, ever watchful in doing good to the people; always you shine in the sky and gleam.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- अग्ने (*agne*)—O Agni
- धीरः (*dhīraḥ*)—steady of mind
- असि हि (*asi hi*)—you are indeed
- अद्मसत् (*admasat*)—eating the oblation
- विप्रो न (*vipro na*)—being wise
- जागृविः (*jāgṛviḥ*)—watchful to do good to the people
- सदा (*sadā*)—always

O Agni, giver of dwelling and far-seeing one, before trouble comes to us from our sinful deeds, before harm comes to us from our enemies, increase our life.

## Sūkta 45 (Maṇḍala 8)

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> आ घा य इति द्विचत्वारिंशदृचं तृतीयं सूक्तं । अत्रेयमनुक्रमणिका ।
> आ घ द्विचत्वारिंशत्रिशोक आद्याग्नेंद्री । अनुक्तगोत्रत्वात्कांविस्त्रिशोक ऋषिः । परं
> गायत्रं प्राग्वत्सप्रेरिति परिभाषया गायत्री छंदः । अनुक्तत्वादिंद्रो देवता ।
> आद्यायास्त्वग्निश्चेंद्रश्च ॥ महाव्रते निष्केवल्ये गायत्रतृचाशीतावेतत्तूक्तं । तथैव
> पंचमारण्यके सूत्रितं । आ घा ये अग्निमिंधत आ तू न इंद्र क्षुमंतमिति सूक्ते ।
> ऐ. आ. ५-२-३ । इति ॥ तृतीये पर्यायेच्छावाकशस्त्र आदितः सप्तदशर्चः । तथैवातिरात्र इति खंडे सूत्यते । आ घा ये अग्निमिंधत इति सप्तदश । आ. ६-९ । इति ॥
> आग्रयण आग्नेंद्रस्य हविष आ घा य इत्येषानुवाक्या । सूत्रितं च । आ घा ये
> अग्निमिंधते सुकर्माणः सुरुचो देवयंत इति स्तोत्रं । आ. २-९ । इति ॥
> मैत्रावरुणातिरिकोक्ष्यॆ स्तोत्रमिंद्रायेत्याद्याः षड्यचो विकल्पेन स्तोत्रियानुरूपाः । सूत्रितं च । तद्वो गाय सुते सचा स्तोत्रमिंद्राय गायत । आ. ९-११ ।
> इति ॥ द्वितीये पर्याये ब्राह्मणाच्छंसिनोऽभि त्वा वृषभेति स्तोत्रियत्त्वचः ।
> सूत्रितं च । अभि त्वा वृषभा सुतेऽभि प्र गोपतिं गिरा । आ. ६-४ । इति ॥ चातुर्विंशिकेऽहनि प्रातःसवने भिंधि विश्वा इति ब्राह्मणाच्छंसिनः षळहस्तोत्रियः । तथा च
> सूत्रितं । भिंधि विश्वा अप द्विष इति ब्राह्मणाच्छंसिनः । आ. ७-२ । इति ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: the hymn beginning आ घा य (*ā ghā ya*) has forty-two Ṛks and is the third sūkta. The Anukramaṇī says of it: आ घ द्विचत्वारिंशत्रिशोक आद्याग्नेंद्री (*ā gha dvicatvāriṃśatriśoka ādyāgneṃdrī*). Because no gotra is stated, the seer is Triśoka Kāṇva **NOTE**. The metre is Gāyatrī by the rule on the metre that follows the preceding one; the deity is Indra, as none is stated; but of the first Ṛk the deities are Agni and Indra. In the Mahāvrata, in the Niṣkevalya śastra, this sūkta is used for the Gāyatra tṛca; so it is laid down in the fifth Āraṇyaka: आ घा ये अग्निमिंधत आ तू न इंद्र क्षुमंतमिति सूक्ते (*ā ghā ye agnimiṃdhata ā tū na iṃdra kṣumaṃtamiti sūkte*) (Ai. Ā. 5-2-3). In the third paryāya, in the Acchāvāka śastra, the first seventeen Ṛks are used; likewise in the Atirātra it is taught in the section so named: आ घा ये अग्निमिंधत इति सप्तदश (*ā ghā ye agnimiṃdhata iti saptadaśa*) (Ā. 6-9). In the Āgrayaṇa, for the oblation to Agni and Indra, the Ṛk आ घा य (*ā ghā ya*) is the anuvākyā; and the sūtra says: आ घा ये अग्निमिंधते सुकर्माणः सुरुचो देवयंत इति स्तोत्रं (*ā ghā ye agnimiṃdhate sukarmāṇaḥ suruco devayaṃta iti stotraṃ*) (Ā. 2-9). In the Maitrāvaruṇa's atirikta-ukthya, the six Ṛks स्तोत्रमिंद्रायेत्याद्याः (*stotramiṃdrāyetyādyāḥ*) are, optionally, stotriyā and anurūpa verses; and the sūtra says: तद्वो गाय सुते सचा स्तोत्रमिंद्राय गायत (*tadvo gāya sute sacā stotramiṃdrāya gāyata*) (Ā. 9-11). In the second paryāya, for the Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin, the Ṛks beginning अभि त्वा वृषभ (*abhi tvā vṛṣabha*) are the stotriya tṛca; and the sūtra says: अभि त्वा वृषभा सुतेऽभि प्र गोपतिं गिरा (*abhi tvā vṛṣabhā sute 'bhi pra gopatiṃ girā*) (Ā. 6-4). On the Cāturviṃśika day, at the morning pressing, the Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin has the ṣaḷaha stotriya beginning भिंधि विश्वा (*bhiṃdhi viśvā*); and so the sūtra says: भिंधि विश्वा अप द्विष इति ब्राह्मणाच्छंसिनः (*bhiṃdhi viśvā apa dviṣa iti brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaḥ*) (Ā. 7-2).

##### Anuvāda

This sūkta beginning आ घा ये (*ā ghā ye*) is the third sūkta in the sixth Anuvāka. It has forty-two Ṛks. In the Anukramaṇī it is said: आ घ द्विचत्वारिंश (*ā gha dvicatvāriṃśa*) ... आद्याग्नेंद्री (*ādyāgneṃdrī*). The seer of this sūkta is one called Triśokaḥ Kāṇvaḥ; the deity is Indra; for the first Ṛk alone the deities are the two, Agni and Indra. The metre is Gāyatrī. In the Mahāvrateṣṭi, at the time of reciting the mantras of the Niṣkevalya śastra, this sūkta is applied for the Ṛks of the Gāyatrī metre; this is stated in the fifth Āraṇyaka of the Aitareya Āraṇyaka by the sentence आ घा ये अग्निमिंधत आ तॊ न इंद्र क्षुमंतमिति सूक्ते (*ā ghā ye agnimiṃdhata ā tò na iṃdra kṣumaṃtamiti sūkte*) (Ai. A. 5-2-3) **NOTE**. In the third paryāya, in the section called Atirātra of the Āśvalāyana Śrauta Sūtra, it is explained by the sūtra आ घा ये अग्निमिंधते इति सप्तदश (*ā ghā ye agnimiṃdhate iti saptadaśa*) (Ā. 6-4) **NOTE**.

### Printed p. 451

In the Āgrayaṇeṣṭi, in the homa with the oblation, addressed to the deities Agni and Indra, this Ṛk beginning आ घा ये (*ā ghā ye*) is to be recited as the anuvākyā mantra; this is explained by the sūtra of the Āśvalāyana Śrauta Sūtra आ घा ये अग्निमिंधते सुकर्माणः सुरुचो देवयुत इति स्तोत्रं (*ā ghā ye agnimiṃdhate sukarmāṇaḥ suruco devayuta iti stotraṃ*) (Ā. 2-9) **NOTE**. Of the mantras to be recited by the priest called Maitrāvaruṇa, the six Ṛks following the twenty-first Ṛk of this sūkta, स्तोत्रमिंद्राय (*stotramiṃdrāya*), are to be recited optionally as stotriyā and anurūpa mantras; this is explained by the sūtra of the Āśvalāyana Śrauta Sūtra तद्दो गाय सुते सचा स्तोत्रमिंद्राय गायत (*taddo gāya sute sacā stotramiṃdrāya gāyata*) (Ā. 9-11). In the second paryāya the priest called Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin is to recite the twenty-second to twenty-fourth Ṛks of this sūkta, beginning अभि त्वा वृषभ (*abhi tvā vṛṣabha*), as the tṛca of the stotra; this is explained by the sūtra of the Āśvalāyana Śrauta Sūtra अभि त्वा वृषभा सुतेऽभि प्रगोपतिं गिरा (*abhi tvā vṛṣabhā sute 'bhi pragopatiṃ girā*) (Ā. 6-4). At the time of the morning pressing on the day of the sacrifice called Cāturviṃśika, the priest called Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin is to recite the fortieth to forty-second Ṛks of this sūkta, beginning भिंडि विश्वा (*bhiṃḍi viśvā*), as the ṣaḷaha-stotriya tṛca; this is explained by the sūtra of the Āśvalāyana Śrauta Sūtra भिंडि विश्वा अप द्विष इति ब्राह्मणाच्छंसिनः (*bhiṃḍi viśvā apa dviṣa iti brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaḥ*) (Ā. 6-2) **NOTE**.

##### Particulars

- Sūkta 45
- Maṇḍala 8; Anuvāka 6; Sūkta 45
- Aṣṭaka 6; Adhyāya 3; Vargas 42, 43, 44, 45, 46, 47, 48, 49
- Number of Ṛks in the sūkta: 42
- Ṛṣi: Triśokaḥ Kāṇvaḥ
- Devatā: 1. Indrāgni; 2-42. Indraḥ
- Chandas: Gāyatrī

#### Ṛk 1

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> आ घा॒ ये अ॒ग्निमिं॑ध॒ते स्त्॒रणंति॑ ब॒र्हिरा॑नु॒षक् ।  
> येषा॒मिंद्रो॒ युवा॒ सखा॑ ॥ १ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> आ । घ । ये । अग्निं । इंथते । स्तृणंति । बर्हिः । अनुषक् ।  
> येषां । इंद्रः । युवा । सखा ॥ १ ॥

### Printed p. 452

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> य ऋषय आ घाभिमुख्येन खल्वग्निमिंधते दीपयंति येषां च युवा
> नित्यतरुण इंद्रः सखा भवति त आनुषगानुपूर्व्येण बर्हिः स्तृणंति ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: those seers who, turned towards us (आ घ (*ā gha*) in the sense of facing), kindle Agni, that is, make it blaze, and whose friend is the ever-young Indra, that is, the ever-youthful one, they spread the sacred grass (बर्हिः (*barhiḥ*)) in due order.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- ये (*ye*)—which seers
- आ घ (*ā gha*)—facing themselves
- अग्निं (*agniṃ*)—Agni
- इंधते (*iṃdhate*)—cause to blaze
- येषां (*yeṣāṃ*)—whose
- युवा (*yuvā*)—ever-young
- इंद्रः (*iṃdraḥ*)—Indra
- सखा (*sakhā*)—friend
- आनुषक् (*ānuṣak*)—in due order
- बर्हिः (*barhiḥ*)—the seat of sacred grass for the sacrifice
- स्तृणंति (*stṛṇaṃti*)—they spread

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

The seers who, turned towards themselves, cause Agni to blaze, and whose friend is the ever-young Indra, spread in due order the seat of sacred grass for the sacrifice; that is to say, they perform the sacrifice.

##### English translation
Those (sages) who kindle Agni, those of whom the ever-young Indra is the friend, continually spread the sacred grass.

##### विशेषविषयगळु (Special Topics)

आनुषक् (*ānuṣak*): for this word Yāska gives the explanation आनुषगिति नामानुपूर्वस्यानुषक्तं भवति । स्त्रणंति बर्हिरानुषक् इत्यपि निगमो भवति (*ānuṣagiti nāmānupūrvasyānuṣaktaṃ bhavati | straṇaṃti barhirānuṣak ityapi nigamo bhavati*) (Ni. 6-14). आनुषक् (*ānuṣak*) means अनुपक्षं (*anupakṣaṃ*), that is: when there are many things, one of them follows another without a gap; one stands adjoining another, joined to it. For the Vedic sentence स्त्रणंति बर्हिरानुषक् (*straṇaṃti barhirānuṣak*) given as the example, the meaning is: they spread the cut sacred grass (बर्हिषि (*barhiṣi*)), used as a seat, in succession, that is, with the blades joined one to another, each following the next without a gap, closely set. Here each blade of grass touches the blade beside it and lies close against it without a gap. **NOTE** Is it proper to use the word आनुषक् (*ānuṣak*) to denote such a meaning?

#### Ṛk 2

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> बृ॒हन्निदि॒ध्म ए॑षां॒ भूरि॑ श॒स्तं पृ॒थुः स्वरुः॑ ।  
> येषा॒मिंद्रो॒ युवा॒ सखा॑ ॥ २ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> वृशन । इत् । इध्मः एषां । भूरि । शक्तं । पृथुः । स्वरुः ।  
> येषां । इंद्रति । युना । सखा । २ :

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> विषामृषीणामिध्यो बृहन्निन्महान् खलु भूरि बहु च शस्तं स्तोत्रं स्यरुश्च
> पृथुर्महान् । सिद्धमन्यत् ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: of those seers the fuel is great, mighty indeed, and the praise is abundant and much, and the स्यरुश्च (*syaruśca*) is broad and large. The rest is established. **NOTE**

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- युवा (*yuvā*)—ever-young
- इंद्रः (*iṃdraḥ*)—Indra
- येषां (*yeṣāṃ*)—to which seers
- सखा (*sakhā*)—he is a friend
- एषां (*eṣāṃ*)—of such seers
- इध्मः (*idhmaḥ*)—the fuel
- बृहन्नित् (*bṛhannit*)—is exceedingly great
- शस्त्रं (*śastraṃ*)—their praise
- भूरि (*bhūri*)—is abundant
- स्वरुः (*svaruḥ*)—their sacrificial post
- पृथुः (*pṛthuḥ*)—is broad

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

The fuel of those seers, to whom the ever-young Indra is a friend, is exceedingly great. Their praise too is abundant. Their sacrificial post is very large.

##### English translation
Ample is their fuel, many their hymns, broad their sacred shaving,- whose frieno is the ever-young Indra.

#### Ṛk 3

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> अयु॑द्ध॒ इद्यु॒धा वृतं॒ शूर॒ आज॑ति॒ सत्व॑भिः ।  
> येषा॒मिंद्रो॒ युवा॒ सखा॑ ॥ ३ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> अयुद्धः । इत् । युधा । वृतं । शूरः । आ । अजति । सत्वभिः ।  
> येषां । इंद्रः । युवा । सखा ॥ ३ ।

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> तेष्वंतर्भूतः कश्चिदयुद्ध इत्प्रागयोद्धैव सन् युधा वृतं योद्धृभिर्भट्टैरावृतं शत्रुं सत्वभिरात्मीयैर्बलैः शूरः सन्नाजति । नमयति ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: among them some one who before was not a fighter, being now a hero with his own powers, subdues, that is, bends down, the enemy surrounded by warriors, by soldiers.

### Printed p. 454

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- युवा (*yuvā*)—ever-young
- इंद्रः (*iṃdraḥ*)—Indra
- येषां (*yeṣāṃ*)—to whom
- सखा (*sakhā*)—is a friend, of such seers the company
- अयुद्ध इत् (*ayuddha it*)—although formerly powerless to fight
- शूरः (*śūraḥ*)—now, having gained strength through Indra's help
- युधा (*yudhā*)—by warriors
- वृतं (*vṛtaṃ*)—the enemy surrounded
- सत्वभिः (*satvabhiḥ*)—by its powers
- आजति (*ājati*)—makes shrink

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

The company of seers, to whom the ever-young Indra is a friend, though formerly powerless to fight, now having gained strength through Indra's help, makes the enemy surrounded by warriors shrink by its own powers.

##### English translation
Though before powerless to combat, the hero by his might now subdues one surrounded by allies, (if helped by those) of whom the ever-young Indra is the friend.

#### Ṛk 4

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> आ बुं॒दं वृ॑त्र॒हा द॑दे जा॒तः पृ॑च्छ॒द्वि मा॒तरं॑ ।  
> क उ॒ग्राः के ह॑ शृण्वरे ॥ ४ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> आ । बुंदं । वृत्रहा । ददे । जातः । पृच्छत् । वि । मातरं ।  
> के । उग्राः । के । ह । शृण्वरे ॥ ४ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> जात उत्पन्नो वृत्रहेंद्रो बुंदमिषुं । कथा च यास्कः । बुंद
> इषुर्भवति । नि. ६-३२ । इति । आ ददे । आदाय चेषुमुग्रा उद्धूर्णबलाः के के च
> शृण्वरे वीर्येण विश्रुता इति स्वमातरं वि पृच्छत् । अप्राक्षीत् ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: Indra, the slayer of Vṛtra, once born, took the arrow (बुंद (*buṃda*) is the arrow); and Yāska says: बुंद इषुर्भवति (*buṃda iṣurbhavati*) (Ni. 6-32). Having taken it, he asked his own mother: who are the fierce, of uplifted strength, and who are renowned for valour.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- वृत्रहा (*vṛtrahā*)—Indra, the slayer of Vṛtra
- जातः (*jātaḥ*)—as soon as he was born
- बुदॆं (*budèṃ*)—his arrow
- आ ददे (*ā dade*)—took in his hand
- उग्राः (*ugrāḥ*)—those of exceeding strength

### Printed p. 455

- ते (*te*)—who are they?
- ते ह (*te ha*)—who and who
- शृण्वरे (*śṛṇvare*)—are so renowned
- मातरं (*mātaraṃ*)—his mother
- वि पृच्छत् (*vi pṛcchat*)—asked

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

Indra, the slayer of Vṛtra, as soon as he was born, took his arrow in his hand and asked his mother: "Who are those of exceeding strength? Who and who are so renowned?"

##### English translation
The slayer of Vritra, as soon as he was born, seized his arrow, and asked his mother, " who are the terrible, who are renowned ?"

#### Ṛk 5

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> प्रति॑ त्वा शव॒सी व॑दद्दि॒रावप्पो॒ न यो॑धिषत् ।  
> यस्ते॑ शत्रु॒त्वमा॑च॒के ॥ ५ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> प्रति । त्वा । शवसी । वदत् । गिरौ । अप्सः । न । योधिषत् ।  
> यः । ते । शत्रुत्वं । आचके ॥ ५ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> हे इंद्र त्वा त्वां शवसी बलवती माता प्रति वदत् । प्रत्यवोचत् । यस्ते
> शत्रुत्वमाचके कामयते स गिरौ पर्वतेऽप्सो न दर्शनीयो गज इव योधिषत् ।
> योधयति ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: O Indra, your mighty mother answered you: whoever desires enmity with you fights on the mountain like an elephant fair to look upon.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- शवसी (*śavasī*)—your mother, endowed with strength
- त्वा (*tvā*)—to you
- प्रति वदत् (*prati vadat*)—gave this answer, namely
- यः (*yaḥ*)—who
- ते (*te*)—with you
- शत्रुत्वं (*śatrutvaṃ*)—enmity
- आ चक्रे (*ā cakre*)—he fosters, he
- निता (*nitā*)—on the mountain **NOTE**
- अप्सो न (*apso na*)—like an attractive elephant
- योधिषत् (*yodhiṣat*)—fights

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O Indra, your mother, endowed with strength, gave you this answer: "He who fosters enmity with you fights on the mountain like an attractive elephant."

### Printed p. 456

##### English translation
The strong mother answered you, "he who wishes your enmity fights as the elephant in the mountain."

#### Ṛk 6

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> उ॒त त्वं म॑घवञ्छणु॒ यस्ते॒ वष्टि॑ व॒नक्षि॒ तत् ।  
> यद्वी॒ळया॑सि वी॒ळु तत् ॥ ६ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> उत । त्वं । मघवन् । शृणु । यः । ते । वष्टि । ववक्षि । तत् ।  
> यश् । वीळयासि । वीळु । तत् ॥ ६ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> उतापि च हे मघवन् त्वं शृण्वस्मदीयां स्तुतिं । ते त्वत्तो यद्वष्टि
> कामयते स्तोता तद्ववक्षि । तस्मै तव्वहसि । किंच त्वं यद्वीळयासि दृढीकरोषि
> तद्वीळु तद्वृढमेव सर्वत्र भवति ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: and, O Maghavan, hear our praise; whatever the praiser desires from you, that you bear to him; and whatever you make firm, that is firm everywhere.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- उत (*uta*)—and
- मघवन् (*maghavan*)—O wealthy Indra
- त्वं (*tvaṃ*)—you
- शृणु (*śṛṇu*)—hear our praise
- ते (*te*)—from you
- यः वष्टि (*yaḥ vaṣṭi*)—whatever the praiser desires
- तत् (*tat*)—that
- ववक्षि (*vavakṣi*)—bear to him
- यत् (*yat*)—what
- वीळॆयागि (*vīḷèyāgi*)—you strengthen
- तत् (*tat*)—that
- वीळु (*vīḷu*)—remains firm

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O wealthy Indra, hear our praise. Whatever the praiser desires from you, bear that to him. Whatever you strengthen remains firm.

##### English translation
O Maghavan, hear (our praise); whoever desires of you, your bear to him his request ; what you fix is sure.

#### Ṛk 7

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> यदा॒जिं यात्या॑जि॒कृदिंद्रः॑ स्वश्व॒युरुष ॑।  
> र॒थीत॑मो र॒थीनां॑ ॥ ७ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> यत् । अजिं । याति । आजैकृत् । इंद्रः । स्वश्वयुः । उप ।  
> रथितमः । रथिनां ॥ ७ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> यद्यदाजिकृद्युद्धकृदिंद्रः स्वश्वयुः कल्याणमश्वमिच्छन्नाजिं युद्धमुप
> याति तदा रथीतमोऽतिशयेन रथी भवति । रथीनां सर्वान्रथिनश्च जयतीति शेषः ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: when Indra, the maker of battle, desiring a good horse, goes up to the battle, then he becomes the foremost of charioteers, and he conquers all charioteers; this last is to be supplied.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- यत् (*yat*)—when
- आजिकृत् (*ājikṛt*)—engaged in battle
- इंद्रः (*iṃdraḥ*)—Indra
- स्वश्वयुः (*svaśvayuḥ*)—desiring an excellent horse
- आजिं (*ājiṃ*)—the battle
- उप याति (*upa yāti*)—approaches, then
- रथीतमः (*rathītamaḥ*)—becomes the possessor of the best chariot
- रथीनां (*rathīnāṃ*)—he conquers all charioteers

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

Indra, engaged in battle, desiring an excellent horse, when he goes to the battle and begins it, then obtains the best chariot. He conquers all charioteers.

##### English translation
When Indra, the warrior, goes to battle, desirous of gallant steeds, he is the foremost of the lords of chariots.

#### Ṛk 8

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> वि सु विश्वा॑ अभि॒युजो॒ वज्र॒न्विस्व॒ग्यथा॑ वृह ।  
> भवा॑ नः सु॒श्रव॑स्तमः ॥ ८ ॥

### Printed p. 458

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> वि । सु । विश्वाः । अभियुजः । वज्रन् । विष्वक् । यथा । वृह ।  
> भव । नः । सुश्रवःतमः ॥ ८ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> ये वज्रिन् त्वं विश्वाः सर्वा अभियुजोऽभियोक्रीः प्रजा यथा विष्वग्भवंति
> तथा सु सुष्टु वि वृह । नोऽस्माकं सुश्रवस्तमः शोभनान्नवत्तमश्च भव ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: O wielder of the thunderbolt, as all the attacking peoples, the assailants, become scattered on every side, so scatter them well; and be for us the best, possessed of fair food.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- वज्रिन् (*vajrin*)—O Indra, bearer of the thunderbolt
- विश्वाः (*viśvāḥ*)—all
- अभियुजः (*abhiyujaḥ*)—the enemies who rush against us
- यथा (*yathā*)—in what manner
- विष्णक् (*viṣṇak*)—so that they are scattered
- सु (*su*)—well
- विवृह (*vivṛha*)—scatter them
- नः (*naḥ*)—to us
- सुश्रवस्तमः (*suśravastamaḥ*)—as the giver of excellent food
- भव (*bhava*)—be

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O Indra, bearer of the thunderbolt, scatter thoroughly all the enemies who rush against us, so that they all run apart in different directions. Be to us a giver of excellent food.

##### English translation
Thunderer, smite all your enemies that they may be scattered,—be to us a most abundant benefactor.

#### Ṛk 9

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> अ॒स्माकं॒ सु रथं॑ पु॒र इंद्रः॑ कृणोतु सा॒तये॑ ।  
> न यं धूर्वं॑ति धू॒र्तयः॑ ॥ ९ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> अस्माकं । सु । रथं । पुरः । इंद्रः । कृणोतु । सातये ।  
> न । यं । धूर्वंति । धूर्तयः ॥ ९ ॥

### Printed p. 459

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> यमिंद्रं धूर्तयोः हिंसका न धूर्वंति न हिंसंति स इंद्रोऽस्माकं
> सातयेऽभीष्टलाभाय सु रथः कल्याणं रथं पुरः कृणोतु । पुरस्करोतु ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: Indra, whom the harmers (धूर्तयोः (*dhūrtayoḥ*)) do not harm, may that Indra, for the attainment of what we desire (सातये (*sātaye*)), put in front, that is, bring forward, a good chariot.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- यं (*yaṃ*)—the Indra whom
- धूर्तयः (*dhūrtayaḥ*)—the harming enemies
- न धूर्वंति (*na dhūrvaṃti*)—cannot harm
- इंद्रः (*iṃdraḥ*)—that same Indra
- अस्माकं (*asmākaṃ*)—for us
- सातये (*sātaye*)—for the obtaining of what we desire
- सु (*su*)—an excellent
- रथं (*rathaṃ*)—chariot
- पुरः (*puraḥ*)—before us
- कृणोतु (*kṛṇotu*)—let him make ready

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

May that same Indra, whom the harming enemies cannot harm, make ready before us an excellent chariot for the obtaining of what we desire.

##### English translation
May Indra, whom no foes can harm, send before us a beautiful chariot for the acquisition (of our desires).

#### Ṛk 10

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> वृ॒ज्याम॑ ते॒ परि॒ द्विषोऽरं॑ ते शक्र दा॒वने॑ ।  
> ग॒मेमेदिं॑द्र॒ गोम॑तः ॥ १० ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> वृज्याम । ते । परि । द्विषः । अरं । ते । शक्र । दावने ।  
> गमेम । इत् । इंद्र । गोऽमतः ॥ १० ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> हे शक्रेंद्र याचमाना वयं ते तव द्विषो द्वेष्टन् परि वृज्याम !
> नोपगच्छेम । किंतु ते तव गोमतः पशुमतो दावनेऽभीष्टदानायारं
> पर्यॊप्तं गमेमेत् । गच्छेमैव ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: O Śakra Indra, we who beg of you may keep away from your enemies, that is, may not go near them; but may we go indeed in abundance, that is, sufficiently, to your giving of the desired gifts, you who are rich in cattle.

### Printed p. 460

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- शक्र (*śakra*)—O mighty one
- इंद्र (*iṃdra*)—O Indra
- ते (*te*)—your
- द्विषः (*dviṣaḥ*)—enemies
- परि वृज्याम (*pari vṛjyāma*)—may we escape
- ते (*te*)—your
- गोमतः (*gomataḥ*)—possessed of cattle
- दावने (*dāvane*)—to receive the gift
- अरं (*araṃ*)—as much as to be satisfied
- गमेमेत् (*gamemet*)—we shall come to you

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O mighty Indra, may we escape your enemies. We come to you in abundance to receive your gift, rich in cattle.

##### English translation
Strong Indra, may we escape your enemies; may we come to you abundantly for your gifts, rich in cattle.

#### Ṛk 11

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> शनै॑श्चि॒द्यंतो॑ अद्रि॒वोऽश्वा॑नंतः शत॒ग्विनः॑ ।  
> वि॒वक्ष॑णा अने॒हसः॑ ॥ ११ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> शनैः । चित् । यंतः । अद्रिवः । अश्ववंतः । शतग्विनः ।  
> विवक्षणाः । अनेकसः ॥ ११ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> हे अद्रिवो वज्रन् वयं शनैर्मंदं मंदं यंतो गच्छंतोऽश्वावंतोऽश्ववंतः शतग्विनो बहुधना विवक्षणा वोधव्यं वहंतोऽनेहस उपद्रवरहिताश्च
> संतो गमेमेदिति संबंधः ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: O wielder of the bolt (अद्रिवो (*adrivo*)), we going slowly, little by little, possessed of horses, of much wealth (शतग्विनो (*śatagvino*) explained as of much wealth), bearing what is to be borne (विवक्षणा (*vivakṣaṇā*)), and free from calamity, may come to you; this is the connection with गमेमेदिति (*gamemediti*) of the preceding Ṛk.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- अद्रिवः (*adrivaḥ*)—O Indra, bearer of the thunderbolt
- शनैः (*śanaiḥ*)—slowly
- यंतः (*yaṃtaḥ*)—we who approach you
- अश्वावंतः (*aśvāvaṃtaḥ*)—possessed of horses
- शतग्विनः (*śatagvinaḥ*)—possessed of abundant wealth
- विवक्षणाः (*vivakṣaṇāḥ*)—bearers of wealth
- अनेहसः (*anehasaḥ*)—free from calamity

### Printed p. 461

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O Indra, bearer of the thunderbolt, may we who approach you slowly be possessed of horses, of abundant wealth, bearers of wealth, and free from calamity.

##### English translation
(May we come), thunderer, slowly approaching you,—may we be rich in horses, possessed of abundant treasure, ready to offer, and unharmed (by calamity).

#### Ṛk 12

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> ऊ॒र्ध्वा हि ते॑ दि॒वेदि॑वे स॒हस्रा॑ सू॒नृता॑ श॒ता ।  
> ज॒रि॒तृभ्यो॑ वि॒मंह॑ते ॥ १२ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> ऊर्ध्वा । हि । ते । दिवेऽदिवे । सहस्रा । सूनृता । शता ।  
> जरितृभ्यः । विमंहते ॥ १२ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> हे इंद्र ते तव जरितृभ्यः स्तोतृभ्यः सहस्रा सहस्राणि शता शतानि चोर्द्वॊर्ध्वानि मुख्यानि सूनृता सूनृतानि साधनानि दिवे दिवेऽन्वहं विमंहते । यजमानः
> प्रयच्छति । मंहतिर्दानकर्मा ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: O Indra, to your praisers, thousands and hundreds of excellent, that is, chief, pleasing gifts (सूनृता (*sūnṛtā*) explained as means), day by day, the sacrificer gives (विमंहते (*vimaṃhate*)). The root मंहतिर्दानकर्मा (*maṃhatirdānakarmā*).

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- ते (*te*)—your
- जरितृभ्यः (*jaritṛbhyaḥ*)—to the praisers
- सहस्रा (*sahasrā*)—by the thousand
- शता (*śatā*)—by the hundred
- ऊर्ध्वा (*ūrdhvā*)—most excellent
- सून्वृता (*sūnvṛtā*)—auspicious
- दिवे दिवे (*dive dive*)—every day
- विमंहते (*vimaṃhate*)—the sacrificer gives

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O Indra, to your praisers the sacrificer gives every day things to be enjoyed, by the thousand and by the hundred, most excellent and auspicious.

### Printed p. 462

##### English translation
(The sacrificer) gives to your praisers day by day hundreds and thousands of excellent and auspicious gifts.

#### Ṛk 13

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> वि॒द्मा हि त्वा॑ धनंज॒यमिंद्र॑ दृ॒ळ्हा चि॑दारु॒जं ।  
> आ॒दा॒रिणं॒ यथा॒ गयं॑ ॥ १३ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> विद्म । हि । त्वा । धनंऽजयं । इंद्र । दृळ्हा । चित् । आरुजं ।  
> आदारिणं । यथा । गयं ॥ १३ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> हे इंद्र त्वा त्वां धनंजयं धनानां जेतारं दृढा चिद्दृढानामपि शत्रूणामारुजमाभिमुख्येन भंक्तारमादारिणमादर्तारं च यथा गयं गृहमिवोपद्रवेभ्यो रक्षकं चॆ विद्म । जानीम ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: O Indra, we know you as the winner of wealth, as the breaker, facing him, of even firm enemies, as the one who bursts open (आदारिणं (*ādāriṇaṃ*) explained in the bhāṣya by भंक्तारमादारिणमादर्तारं (*bhaṃktāramādāriṇamādartāraṃ*)), and, like a house, as the protector from calamities.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- इंद्र (*iṃdra*)—O Indra
- त्वा (*tvā*)—you
- धनंजयं (*dhanaṃjayaṃ*)—as the winner of wealth from enemies
- दृढा चित् (*dṛḍhā cit*)—even the most powerful enemies
- अरुजं (*arujaṃ*)—as the one who destroys
- आदारिणं (*ādāriṇaṃ*)—as the one who makes a way
- यथा गयं (*yathā gayaṃ*)—as the protector from calamity like a house
- विद्म हि (*vidma hi*)—we have known

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O Indra, we have known you as the winner of wealth, as the one who subdues even the most powerful enemies, as the one who makes a way for us, and, like a house, as the protector from calamity.

##### English translation
We know you, Indra, as the conqueror of wealth, the breaker of firm obstacles, the opener, and (guarding from harm) as a house

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> क॒कु॒हं चि॑त्वा कवे॒ मंदं॑तु धृष्ण॒विंद॑वः ।  
> आ त्वा॑ प॒णिं यदीम॑हे ॥ १४ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> ककुहं । चित् । त्वा । कवे । मंदंतु । धृष्णो इति । इंदवः ।  
> आ । त्वा । पणिं । यत् । ईमहे ॥ १४ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> हे कवे क्रांतकर्मन् धृष्णो धर्षकेंद्र यद्यदा पणिं पणमानं त्वा
> श्वामा अभिमुख्येनेमहे अभीष्यं याचामहे तदा ककुहमुच्छ्रितं त्वा
> श्वामिंदवश्चित् सोमा आपि मंदंतु । मादयंतु ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: O seer, O bold Indra, the assailer, when we, facing you, the one who barters (पणिं (*paṇiṃ*) explained as पणमानं (*paṇamānaṃ*)), ask for what we desire, then let the Soma drops delight you who are exalted (ककुहमुच्छ्रितं (*kakuhamucchritaṃ*)). **NOTE**

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- कवे (*kave*)—O one of far-reaching works
- धृष्णो (*dhṛṣṇo*)—O assailer of enemies, Indra
- यत् (*yat*)—when
- पणिं (*paṇiṃ*)—you who are the one who barters
- त्वा (*tvā*)—you
- आ (*ā*)—facing you
- ईमहे (*īmahe*)—we ask, then
- ककुहं (*kakuhaṃ*)—who are in an exalted place
- त्वा (*tvā*)—you
- इंदवः चित् (*iṃdavaḥ cit*)—the Soma juices also
- मंदंतु (*maṃdaṃtu*)—let them satisfy

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O Indra, of far-reaching works, assailer of enemies, when, approaching you who are the one who barters, we ask of you, then let the Soma juices satisfy you who are in an exalted place.

##### English translation
Wise (Indra), overcomer enemies, when we solicit you the barterer, may the drops of the Soma exhilarate you the exalted one.

> यस्ते॑ रे॒वा अदा॑शुरिः प्रम॒मर्ष॑ म॒घत्त॑ये ।  
> तस्य॑ नो॒ वेद॒ आ भ॑र ॥ १५ ॥

### Printed p. 464

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> यः । ते । रेवान् । अदाशुरिः । प्रममर्ष । मघत्तये ।  
> तस्य । नः । वेदः । आ । भर ॥ १५ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> हे इंद्र मघत्तये धनदानाय ते तुभ्यं यः पुमान्रेवान् धनवान्

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: O Indra, whatever man, though rich, being niggardly (अदाशुरि (*adāśuri*) explained as not given to giving), shows envy at giving wealth to you (मघत्तये (*maghattaye*) explained as for the giving of wealth), of that man bring us the wealth (वेदः (*vedaḥ*) explained as wealth).

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- यः (*yaḥ*)—the man who
- रेवान् (*revān*)—though wealthy
- अदाशुरिः (*adāśuriḥ*)—being ungenerous
- ते (*te*)—to you
- मघत्तये (*maghattaye*)—to offer wealth
- प्रममर्ष (*pramamarṣa*)—shows impatience
- तस्य (*tasya*)—of such a man
- वेदः (*vedaḥ*)—the wealth
- नः (*naḥ*)—to us
- आ भर (*ā bhara*)—bring

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O Indra, of that man who, though wealthy, being ungenerous, shows impatience at offering wealth to you, bring the wealth to us.

##### English translation

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> हे इंद्र त्वा त्वां सोमिनोभिपुतसोमाः सखायॆ इम उ इम एव
> खल्वष्टिः इ जनित प्रज्ञावंतः सुभृतधासा यभा पशुं पशुमिव वि चक्षते ।

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: O Indra, these Soma-pressers, whose Soma has been pressed, your friends, indeed look upon you, as पुष्पावंतः (*puṣpāvaṃtaḥ*) look upon their cattle (पशुं पशुमिव (*paśuṃ paśumiva*)); वि चक्षते (*vi cakṣate*) means "they look closely". **NOTE**

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- इंद्र (*iṃdra*)—O Indra
- यथा (*yathā*)—as
- पुष्पावंतः (*puṣpāvaṃtaḥ*)—herdsmen holding grass
- पशुं (*paśuṃ*)—the animal
- वि चक्षते (*vi cakṣate*)—look upon with regard
- सोमिनः (*sominaḥ*)—those who hold Soma
- सखायः (*sakhāyaḥ*)—your friends
- इमे (*ime*)—these sacrificers
- त्वा (*tvā*)—you

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O Indra, as herdsmen holding grass look upon their cattle with regard, so these sacrificers, who hold Soma and are your friends, are looking upon you.

##### English translation

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> श्रवणपरकर्णं संतं त्वा त्वां वयं त्रिशोका इद यज्ञ ऊतये रक्षणाय

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: And, O Indra, you who are not deaf, whose organ of hearing is unimpaired and therefore whose ears are intent on hearing, we, here at this sacrifice, call from afar for protection (ऊतये (*ūtaye*) means "for protection"). **NOTE**

- उत (*uta*)—and

- वयं (*vayaṃ*)—we

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa says: And, O Indra, whenever we, afflicted by poverty, come to you and अमन्महि (*amanmahi*) (he glosses it with a word read here as विष्णुमः (*viṣṇumaḥ*)), then know that "I shall be a giver of cattle to us" (गोदा इत् (*godā it*)); बोधि (*bodhi*) means "know". **NOTE**

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- अपि चित् (*api cit*)—moreover
- ते (*te*)—you
- यत् हि (*yat hi*)—whenever
- व्यथिः (*vyathiḥ*)—afflicted by poverty
- जगन्वांसः (*jaganvāṃsaḥ*)—we who approach you
- आमन्महि (*āmanmahi*)—we praise
- नः (*naḥ*)—to us
- गोदा इत् (*godā it*)—surely that you should give cattle
- बोधि (*bodhi*)—know

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)
